decision.legacy_comparator_problem: It compares openpyxl object serialization and sparse dimension records. Excel SaveAs adds font metadata and empty border elements, converts row-height units, and coalesces equivalent column records even when Excel-effective formatting is unchanged.
decision.acceptance_impact: The legacy 558 formatting/dimension blocker is resolved for the fixed EX02 files and Excel environment. The old FAIL remains immutable; this record is the separate adjudication.
